summary: Full backend + frontend test of iteration 12 (Goals CRUD/reorder, AI What-If purchase simulator, tabbed Settings). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py with 40 pytest cases covering Goals CRUD + reorder + cross-user isolation, Settings preferences (defaults/partial patch/deep-merge/enum coercion), Settings export isolation, What-If scenario (4 options, no-mutation proof, validation, empty-profile path), apply-pin memory-only writes, and regressions (login/me/auth-config/google endpoints/overview/chat streaming/learn/demo). All 40 backend tests PASS. Frontend: Goals page (reorder arrows + persistence + edit + custom delete modal) 100% pass; Settings (6 tabs, currency/threshold/notification persistence across reload, JSON export download, custom reset modal) 100% pass; What-If produced 4 real Claude Sonnet 5 scenario cards. ONE functional frontend bug found: the 'Pinned to AI memory' badge never renders after 'Apply this plan'.

minor.issue: Uses the full GoalInput model, so name/target_amount/deadline are mandatory on every PATCH. It is not a true partial update - a client that only wants to change priority must resend the whole object.
Requires auth, so the publicly reachable /demo/whatif page always fails with 401 for guests (see frontend issue). Either allow a demo snapshot path or gate the page.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Apply this plan' the pin succeeds server-side (200, memory written) but the UI never shows the 'Pinned to AI memory' badge and the button stays visible. RCA: applyPlan() does setPinnedId(data?.memory_id || opt.id) (line 58) while ScenarioCard receives pinned={pinnedId === opt.id} (line 134). memory_id is always returned by the backend (e.g. 'whatif_plan_laptop_1756...') so it never equals opt.id. Fix: setPinnedId(opt.id). Verified: whatif-pinned-best count = 0, whatif-apply-best still present after a successful POST.

/demo/whatif is reachable without auth; running a simulation shows the raw backend string 'Not authenticated' in the error box. No sign-up CTA and no demo fallback. Reproduced with cleared localStorage: POST /api/whatif/scenario -> 401.
catch block is empty (`catch (err) { /* silent */ }`) - if pinning fails the user gets zero feedback and the button just does nothing.
`catch {}` swallows reorder failures. Local state shows the new order while the server keeps the old one, so the UI silently reverts on the next reload with no error surfaced.
`g.priority.toLowerCase()` (lines 437, 447) will throw a TypeError and blank the whole Goals page for any legacy goal document without a `priority` field. Needs `(g.priority || 'Medium')`.

issues: 'Purchase date (optional)' uses the browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the app's own calendar component - inconsistent with the rest of the product and shows a US date order for an INR/India-focused app.
'Delete goal' primary action uses very light red text on a very light pink background (danger-btn); contrast is noticeably below the Cancel button and hard to read.
Spec mentions 'drag handles' but no grip/handle icon is rendered; the whole card is draggable (draggable=true confirmed) with no affordance other than the helper sentence in the intro text.

action_items: HIGH: In /app/frontend/src/pages/WhatIf.jsx line 58 change setPinnedId(data?.memory_id || opt.id) to setPinnedId(opt.id) so the 'Pinned to AI memory' badge (data-testid=whatif-pinned-*) actually renders.

MEDIUM: Handle guest/demo mode on the What-If page - either hide/disable 'Run simulation' with a sign-up CTA when isDemo, or map the 401 to a friendly message instead of showing the raw 'Not authenticated' detail.
MEDIUM: Surface an error in applyPlan()'s catch block instead of failing silently.
LOW: Surface reorder failures from persistOrder() and re-sync from the server on failure.
LOW: Guard g.priority with a default in the Goals card so a goal without priority cannot crash the page.
LOW: Make PATCH /api/goals/{id} accept a partial payload (separate GoalPatchInput with all-optional fields).
DESIGN: Replace the native date input on What-If with the app's calendar component; raise contrast on the danger 'Delete goal' button; add a visible drag handle on goal cards.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _load_ordered_goals(): _clean() pops created_at before the sort key is computed, so the `str(g.get('created_at',''))` tiebreaker in _key() is always '' - dead code. Capture created_at before cleaning if the tiebreaker is intended.

features.py _compute_scenario_option(): `dips_into_savings` uses two completely different formulas depending on months_delay (`price > cash_available - savings` vs `remaining_cash < savings*0.5`), which makes the Buy Now vs delayed comparison inconsistent. Observed effect: Buy Now shows 'Uses savings reserve' while the 3-month option does not, even though both spend the same price.

features.py: the goal-impact 'drain' formula (`max(0, price - saved_before_purchase)` weighted by priority / len(goals)) can attribute a delay to goals whose monthly_contribution is unrelated to the purchase; verify the intent - a 100k laptop produced +2/+3/+3 months across 3 goals (8 months total) for a user with 275k savings.

App.js: usePreferences() is instantiated independently in FinancialPreferencesSection and NotificationsSection, causing two GET /settings/preferences calls and two divergent copies of prefs state. Lift it to a shared context/parent.
App.js is 1362 lines - Goals, Settings, Chat, Dashboard and 8 sub-sections should be split into separate files per the 700-line guideline.

rca_of_the_issue: What-If pin badge: POST /api/whatif/scenario/apply returns {pinned: true, memory_id: 'whatif_plan_<name>_<ts>'}. WhatIf.jsx stores that memory_id in `pinnedId`, but ScenarioCard is rendered with `pinned={pinnedId === opt.id}` where opt.id is one of buy_now|after_3m|after_6m|best. The two values can never match, so `pinned` stays false, the whatif-pinned-* badge never mounts and the 'Apply this plan' button never disappears - giving the user no confirmation despite a successful server write (verified: 0 failed API calls, memory count +1 in /api/settings/export). One-line fix: setPinnedId(opt.id).
